summary: Pulse Biosciences filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a commercial and clinical partnership with the Clayman Thyroid Center at the Hospital for Endocrine Surgery in Tampa, Florida, announced October 14, 2026. The collaboration covers commercial use of the nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System for benign thyroid nodules and joint real-world and formal clinical data collection. No financial terms, equity stakes, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. This is an ordinary business development event, not a special situation; watch for clinical data readouts and any subsequent commercial expansion.
